one_liner: E-commerce platform and SaaS API for managing products, orders, customers, and store settings.
access_notes: Developers can sign up for a free trial store and generate self-serve API credentials or app-level credentials.
verdict_reason: BigCommerce provides self-serve trial stores, fully documented REST and GraphQL APIs, and clear developer tooling.

evidence.snippet: Most of our REST endpoints and GraphQL Admin API endpoints use the X-Auth-Token header to authenticate to BigCommerce servers.
Sign up for a free BigCommerce trial store to test API calls and build integrations without affecting live data.
OAuth API accounts can subscribe to real-time event notifications using BigCommerce’s webhooks.
